meta.title: UCOLIS - Peer-to-peer parcel delivery anywhere in Algeria
meta.description: UCOLIS connects individuals sending a parcel with those who carry it, anywhere in Algeria: negotiated prices, verified carriers, live GPS tracking and code-confirmed handover.

hero.subtitle: Post your parcel in under 3 minutes, get offers from people ready to carry it, pick the right price and follow the delivery live until handover.

how.title: Two ways to use UCOLIS, one single app
how.subtitle: The same account lets you send and carry. Your role is decided parcel by parcel.

sender.title: Post your listing
sender.body: Departure, destination, a title and your price: you're live. A suggested price, based on distance and weight, guides you.

sender.title: Receive offers
sender.body: Carriers accept your price or propose their own. Compare their ratings, badges and vehicles, then negotiate.

sender.title: Follow it live
sender.body: As soon as the trip starts, the carrier's position appears on the map. Chat and calls are open between the two of you.

sender.title: Confirm the handover
sender.body: The recipient gives the 4-digit code to the carrier. The delivery is complete and you can rate each other.

carrier.title: Create your profile
carrier.body: Add your vehicles and get your identity verified: the "Verified identity" badge reassures senders.

carrier.title: Post your trips
carrier.body: Sétif → Algiers every Thursday? Post the trip and its stops: matching parcels are suggested to you automatically.

carrier.title: Make your offers
carrier.body: Accept the asking price in one tap or propose yours. Up to 3 rounds of negotiation, no surprises.

carrier.title: Deliver and get rated
carrier.body: Start the delivery, enter the recipient's code, and watch your rating and success rate climb.

features.title: Everything you need for worry-free shipping
features.subtitle: Designed for Algeria, in French and Arabic, readable even in bright sunlight.

items.title: Quick posting
items.body: One screen is enough. Add weight, dimensions, date and recipient later if you wish.

items.title: Fair suggested price
items.body: A single rate scale computes a starting price from distance, size and fragility, below the rates of delivery companies.

items.title: Clear negotiation
items.body: Offers, counter-offers and one-tap acceptance. The final price is locked as soon as you choose.

items.title: Live GPS tracking
items.body: The carrier's marker moves across the map, with the time of the last position received.

items.title: Built-in messaging
items.body: Text and photos once the offer is accepted. Phone numbers are only shared between the two parties.

items.title: Handover code
items.body: 4 encrypted digits, known only to the sender: the parcel goes to the right person.

items.title: Alerts and favourites
items.body: Save a Sétif → Algiers search and get notified as soon as a listing matches.

items.title: Bilingual FR / AR
items.body: The whole app switches to Arabic, right to left, with wilaya and commune names translated.

simulator.title: How much does your shipment cost?
simulator.subtitle: The same rate scale as the app, applied as the crow flies between wilaya centres. The final price is negotiated with the carrier.
simulator.disclaimer: Indicative estimate. In the app, the distance is calculated between your exact addresses.
simulator.cta: Post this parcel in the app

tracking.title: Your parcel, live on the map
tracking.body: As soon as the carrier sets off, their position is shared with you, and only during the delivery. You know where your parcel is at every moment.
bullets: Alert if no position is received for 5 minutes
Call and chat in one tap from the tracking screen

trust.title: A community built on trust
trust.subtitle: Clear rules, enforced by the app and by a moderation team.

items.title: Verified identities
items.body: ID card, driving licence, vehicle registration and insurance checked by the UCOLIS team.

items.title: Double-blind reviews
items.body: Each side rates without seeing the other's rating: honest reviews, never retaliation.

items.title: Code-based handover
items.body: Without the right code, the delivery must be confirmed by the sender, or automatically after 72 h.

items.title: Arbitrated disputes
items.body: A problem? Open a dispute with photos: the moderation team reviews it, backed by the GPS history.

items.title: Privacy protected
items.body: Phone never public, location shared only during the delivery, compliant with law 18-07.

items.title: Report and block
items.body: Report a listing or a behaviour, block a user in one tap.

carriers.title: Carry parcels, earn an income
carriers.subtitle: With your car or van, carry other people's parcels and set your price. Got a regular trip? Post it to receive matching parcels. Transport professionals are welcome too.

bullets.title: Matching parcels, automatically
bullets.body: Post your trip: parcels that fall along your route are suggested to you.

bullets.title: New parcels near you
bullets.body: A notification as soon as a parcel is posted within 30 km.

bullets.title: Your price, your call
bullets.body: Accept the asking price or propose yours. Payment is settled directly with the sender.

join.title: Why drive with UCOLIS?

perks: The sender pays you the delivery price directly

Up to 20 parcels and 10 active trips at the same time
Listing duplication to post in bulk

faq.title: Got questions?
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions we hear most often.

items.a: Yes. Creating an account, posting listings and making offers is free. The delivery price is agreed between the sender and the carrier and paid directly between them. Senders never pay a commission.

UCOLIS is a technical intermediary that connects users: the platform is not a party to any agreement between the sender and the carrier and never takes possession of parcels. Price, carriage, delivery and payment are the sole responsibility of the parties. UCOLIS is therefore not liable for the loss, theft, damage or delay of a parcel, for its contents, or for payments between users. The review of a dispute by the moderation team creates no liability on its part. Details are set out in article 21 of the terms of use.

No. UCOLIS is designed for parcels sent between individuals, but online shops and transport companies can use it too. They can request business status to get the "Verified pro" badge and higher limits.

items.q: Do I need an account to use the app?
items.a: Without an account, you can browse listings, trips and public profiles. To post, make an offer or send a message, you need an account with a verified email.

items.q: Can I send and carry with the same account?
items.a: Yes. Your choice at sign-up only shapes the interface. Your rights are decided parcel by parcel: parcel owner or selected carrier.

items.q: How is the suggested price calculated?
items.a: It depends on the distance between departure and destination, the parcel size (actual weight or volume) and its fragility. It is a starting point: the final price is negotiated with the carrier.
A carrier accepts your price or proposes another. You can accept, decline or make up to 3 counter-offers. Once an offer is accepted, the price is locked and messaging opens.
Cash, weapons, illegal products, hazardous materials, live animals and unpackaged perishable goods. You confirm this with every listing.
A 4-digit code generated when the offer is accepted, visible only to you. Send it to the recipient: they give it to the carrier, who enters it to complete the delivery.

items.q: What if the carrier doesn't have the code?
items.a: They can declare the delivery with a photo. You then have 72 h to confirm receipt or open a dispute; without a response, the delivery is validated automatically.

items.q: Who can see my phone number?
items.a: No one publicly. It is only visible between the sender and the selected carrier, from acceptance until 7 days after delivery.

items.q: How do I become a carrier?
items.a: Add a vehicle from your profile, then send your documents (ID card, driving licence, vehicle registration, insurance) to get the "Verified identity" badge.

items.q: How much does UCOLIS cost for a carrier?
items.a: Nothing for now. A commission may be introduced later; you will be notified in advance, with an effective date and a welcome bonus in your wallet.

items.q: Can I withdraw after being selected?
items.a: Yes, as long as the delivery hasn't started. The withdrawal is visible on your profile and counts towards your success rate.
